name: Consult Master Gadrin
summary: Apothecary Lydon found the venom from the broodguards less potent than the sample you first brought, which points to another kind of spider. Lydon sends you to Master Gadrin in Sen'jin Village, in Durotar, who may know more.

sections.title: A Search for Potency
sections.body: Apothecary Lydon found the venom taken from the broodguards weaker than the sample you brought first, so it must come from a different spider. Lydon wants a fresh sample of the stronger kind. To learn where it comes from, ask a troll well acquainted with the Witherbark: Master Gadrin, in Sen'jin Village, in Durotar. With luck, Gadrin can name the source of that venom.

faq.q: Why does Apothecary Lydon send you to Master Gadrin?
faq.answer: The broodguard venom was weaker than the first sample, which points to a different spider. Gadrin is a troll well acquainted with the Witherbark and may be able to name the source of that venom.
Master Gadrin is in Sen'jin Village, in Durotar.
Before this you brought Apothecary Lydon an undamaged venom sac from the Hinterlands.
